issues.description: Some practical recommendations in the section are labelled as "general background knowledge" (e.g. in step 2 and step 3), but other similar unsourced practical advice (e.g. the opening recommendation to start by choosing a template and adapt it) is presented without an explicit label or citation.
issues.required_fix: Either add supporting citations for those unsourced recommendations or explicitly mark them as "general background knowledge" to make the provenance clear and consistent.

issues.description: The quick-start procedure omits an explicit reminder to check licensing, data‑handling (DPA/GDPR) and enterprise vs. personal feature availability before deploying prompts, which is emphasised elsewhere in the manual (checklists for guarantors / institutional deployment).
issues.required_fix: Add a brief pre-deployment step or inline note advising to verify license/features and data‑processing constraints and to consult the guarantor/IT checklist (reference the relevant sections/checklists). Provide citations to the guide's checklist / licensing notes.

issues.description: The 3‑step quick start is high-level and could be more actionable: e.g. it asks to 'adjust parameters' (tone, length, level) but gives no compact example of how to phrase such parameterization within a prompt.
issues.required_fix: Add a one‑line example showing how to specify tone, student level and output format in a prompt (this is a pedagogical clarity improvement; it can be left as general guidance or supported by an illustrative example).

issues.description: No LaTeX syntax errors detected, but the text mixes inline parenthetical labels "(general background knowledge)" inside enumerate items and paragraphs; this is acceptable but could interrupt rendering/flow in some stylesheets.
issues.required_fix: Consider moving provenance labels (e.g. 'general background knowledge') to footnotes or a short provenance legend for consistency in the LaTeX output.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Add an explicit short pre-deployment note (before the 3‑step list): 'Před nasazením ověřte dostupnost požadovaných funkcí v zvolené licenci a pravidla zpracování dat (DPA/GDPR); informujte studenty o způsobu použití AI a případně proveďte DPIA podle lokálních předpisů.' Add a footnote referencing the guide's checklist for guarantors / institutional deployment (sections on licensing and DPIA).

Expand step 2 with a short concrete example, e.g.: "Přizpůsobte parametry (příklad: 'Tón: formální; Úroveň: bakalářské studium; Délka odpovědi: 150–200 slov; Formát: Moodle/Forms CSV')." Mark this example as an illustrative snippet (general background knowledge) or cite a template example from the prompt library if available.

Ensure all advisory sentences that are not directly supported by KB excerpts are either (a) given a supporting citation from the manual, or (b) explicitly labelled 'general background knowledge'. Make the labelling consistent (prefer footnotes or a short parenthetical legend).

Add a one‑line cross‑reference to the guarantor/IT checklists (e.g. 'Viz sekce Bezpečnostní opatření a Checklist pro garanty') immediately after the practical deployment examples to guide implementers to security/licensing guidance.
